# Klinik Psykiatri Syd, Aalborg Universitetshospital

Klinik Psykiatri Syd, Aalborg Universitetshospital is a psychiatric clinic within Region Nordjylland in Denmark, appearing once in the corpus in connection with the ADHD-databasen (ADHD database) documentation for the reporting period 1. april 2024 – 31. marts 2025 [^src1]. According to the entity's stated significance, this is the clinic where Ib Rasmussen works as overlæge (chief physician/senior consultant) [^src1], though no explicit relationship or claim linking the two was extracted from the source text itself.

The mention places the clinic within the broader context of the ADHD database's steering group (styregruppe), which draws members from all five Danish regions, professional societies, patient organizations, and Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut (the Danish Healthcare Quality Program) [^src1]. The surrounding pages of the source document also contain appendices detailing the number and demographic distribution of ADHD assessment and treatment pathways among children, young people, and adults, as well as regional variations in the use of a pathway marker for disproved suspicions of ADHD [^src1]. Klinik Psykiatri Syd's inclusion in this material suggests it is one of the regional psychiatric units represented in, or relevant to, this national quality-assurance effort, but the data provided does not specify its exact role beyond the single listing.

Given the limited evidence — a single mention, no relationships, and no independent claims — this is an honestly thin entity page. No further details about the clinic's history, patient population, or formal role in the ADHD database steering group are available from the extracted material.
